// Package claim is a fixture for the placement checks.
package claim

// Claimer claims pods.
//
// spec: CLAIM-R4
type Claimer struct {
	// spec: CLAIM-R5
	Hold int
	TTL  int // spec: setting-claimholdttlseconds
	// Plain field comment.
	Name string
}

// Claim refuses a claim past the limit.
//
// spec: CLAIM-R4
func (c *Claimer) Claim() error {
	// spec: CLAIM-R6
	if c.Hold > 0 {
		return nil
	}
	f := func() int {
		// spec: CLAIM-R7
		return 1
	}
	_ = f()
	return nil
}

// limit is a defined value.
//
// spec: limit-maxclaims
const limit = 10
